newsitem.title: UK: UK engineering turnover up 0.4 pct in 3mths to Oct.
newsitem.headline: UK engineering turnover up 0.4 pct in 3mths to Oct.

text.p: Total turnover of the UK engineering industries in the three months to October 1996 increased by 0.4 per cent compared with the previous three months.

This was due to an increase of 0.9 percent in export turnover combined with an increase of 0.1 percent in home turnover. Compared to the same period a year ago total turnover increased by 0.5 percent.
Total orders on hand at the end of October increased by 0.4 percent compared to the level at the end of July 1996, and were 4.6 percent down on October 1995.
